title: Compact-support description of the global Frobenius
statement:
Fix the global finite-field
datum and the coefficient
conventions, and let $(K,\varphi)\in D^b_{ctf,\mathrm W}(X,A)$. Then
the $m$-th iterate $F_{c,K}^{\,m}$ of the global geometric
Frobenius of [def-trf-frobenius-operators] is the composite

$$
F_{c,K}^{\,m}=R\Gamma_c(X,\varphi^{[m]})\circ g_{\gamma,c}^{m,*},
$$

where $\varphi^{[m]}$ is the iterated Weil isomorphism of
[def-trf-iterated-weil-map] and $g_{\gamma,c}^{m,*}$ is the
compact-support base-change isomorphism along the automorphism
$g_\gamma^m$ of the
global geometric
Frobenius action.

proof.text: Use the single canonical direct power-square transport compactDirectPowerTransport, with finiteGlobalDirectPowerTransport now its abbreviation (definition-merger record B4-frobenius-compact-description-proof-context). It is constructed from the point transport and the retained-compactification exchange, not by iterating degree one. The underlying carrier of a strict Weil complex is bounded constructible, as the first conjunct of its finite-Tor constructible predicate. Expand finiteGlobalFrobenius and apply compact_direct_power_transport_normalization to this carrier. Its equality gives exactly the compact-support formula, and its final clause makes the direct arrow invertible.

At level n+1 the functor finiteGlobalCompactSections is definitionally the compactPowerCohomology used in compactWeilCocycleEndomorphism. Expand only compactDirectPowerTransport and compactWeilCocycleEndomorphism, then use preservation of composition and associativity to identify finiteGlobalFrobenius at predecessor i with U_(i+1). Apply the successor clause of compact_weil_cocycle_endomorphism_recurrence to obtain F_(i+1)=F_i followed by F_0.

Induct on the predecessor r of the positive exponent. At r=0 the assertion is pow_one. At the successor substitute the recurrence of step 3 and the induction hypothesis, then use the opposite-composition multiplication of categorical endomorphisms and pow_succ′. Combine this power equality with the formula and invertibility obtained in step 2. The coefficient level zero case is excluded by the existing positive-level hypothesis.
